title: S01T02 - Reconcile live command, storage, surface, and documentation truth
description: Eliminate contradictions between the live command registry, object/file storage behavior, generated references, architecture docs, and public onboarding.
acceptanceCriteria: All public docs agree with the live registry on command count, flags, storage backend, generated artifacts, and implemented versus experimental interfaces.
A registry-backed docs check fails CI when command or storage documentation drifts.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
